name: integrity-check
design: 2-cover: every merge independently judged by 2 checkers; GENUINE only if both agree. Anti-fabrication gate, NOT a novelty gate (R6).

per_merge.reason: K5: iGRPO is iterative/revisable, has no irreversible 'commit'; Beck monadicity is about coequalizers, not staged gating -> unifier mischaracterizes 2 of 3 components.

Both: coend does not DERIVE dynamin's cooperativity threshold (26 subunits is real structural-biology geometry, cited post-hoc); DART pruning is N-gram, not a coend selector. Mechanism is a category-theory pun.
K7: Kohn anomaly is single-particle Lindhard screening with NO game-theoretic externality; labeling it 'externality-gated' borrows VCG vocabulary for an absent mechanism.

K8: Rashba spin-momentum chirality has no formal isomorphism to STDP temporal asymmetry; 'chirality coefficient' is undefined in STDP; conflates a coupling constant with a preference-ranking condition.

Both: components accurate (QUEST 2604.00199, Kohn 2k_F, hexagonal grid reciprocal lattice); shared 'privileged reciprocal-space shell' is geometrically grounded across all three; GridPE is closest prior art but lacks the Kohn/2k_F + QUEST dimensions. Genuinely uncombined.
K6: iGRPO has NO ~20x fast/slow dual-head; its Stage-2 refinement is slower, not faster -> the 'two-velocity' mapping factually misstates iGRPO's architecture.

Both: components accurate (Beck split-coequalizers, Cas9 R->I->D checkpoint, VCG Clarke pivot); 'sequential conditions before irreversible commit' is at least structurally present in all three; no prior art for the triple. Both flag the abstract bridge as the weakest link (medium confidence).

Both: components accurate (Myerson-Satterthwaite, E1-E2-E3 ATP cost, Grothendieck fibration); 'indexed-type resource impossibility under hidden fiber data' is coherent (hidden substrate identity = private type; ATP deficit = budget deficit); no prior combination.

metrics.redundancy_flip_note: M1-T1, M2-T1, M2-T2, M3-T2 were each rated GENUINE by their first checker and caught only by the second. Without the 2-cover, the pass set would have been 7/8; with it, 3/8 -> redundancy removed ~57% of first-look passes. Direct empirical support for R3/R10 (hallucination reduction via redundant cross-check).

meta_integrity_caution: Two checkers (K1, K6) cited recent arXiv IDs as 'closest prior art' near-misses (2603.08239 'Fibration Policy Optimization'; 2510.04072 'Slow-Fast Policy Optimization') that were NOT independently re-verified and may themselves be checker hallucinations. They were not load-bearing (used only to argue 'not a collision'), but this exposes a residual fabrication vector: checkers must verify their own cited near-miss IDs.
